title: RN & LPN Services for the Outpatient Dept.-Rosebud Indian Health Service (IHS) Hospital
agency: HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES, DEPARTMENT OF > INDIAN HEALTH SERVICE > GREAT PLAINS AREA INDIAN HEALTH SVC
description:
Sources Sought:  RN & LPN Services for the Outpatient Dept.-Rosebud Indian Health Service (IHS) Hospital 

  

 Sources Sought Notice Number:  IHS1533339  

 This Sources Sought Notice is for informational and planning purposes only and shall not be construed as a solicitation, an obligation or commitment by the Indian Health Service. 

 This notice is intended strictly for market research to determine the availability of Indian Small Business Economic Enterprise (ISBEE), Indian Economic Enterprise (IEE), or Other Small Businesses. 

 Your responses to the information requested will assist the Government in determining the appropriate acquisition method, including whether a set-aside is possible. The anticipated applicable NAICS code for this acquisition is 561320- Temporary Help Services 

  1.0        BACKGROUND  

 The Rosebud Indian Health Service Hospital requires supplemental clinical staff in the amount of five (5) RNs and five (5) LPNs for the Outpatient Department.  

  2.0       OBJECTIVE  

 The primary objective of this project is to establish Registered Nurse (RN) and Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) contract personnel for the Outpatient Department-Rosebud IHS Hospital. The contract personnel shall provide outpatient nursing and clinical support functions in accordance with attached Performance Work Statement (PWS). 

  3.0      CONTRACT REQUIREMENTS/ AND PERSONNEL QUALIFICATIONS  

 Contractor shall provide appropriately licensed, credentialed, and qualified RN and LPN personnel to perform outpatient nursing and clinical support functions. Contractor personnel shall perform services in accordance with attached PWS, authorized practitioner orders, applicable clinical protocols, credentialing and privileging requirements, facility policies, and the scope of practice associated with each professional license. 

  4.0      TYPE OF ORDER  

 The Government anticipates a commercial acquisition; contract type has not yet been determined and will be informed by market research results. 

  5.0      ANTICIPATED PERIOD OF PERFORMANCE  

 Period of Performance: One (1) year base period plus two (2) one (1) year option periods 

  6.0      PLACE OF PERFORMANCE  

 400 Soldier Creek Dr. Rosebud, SD 57570 

  7.0      Capability Statement/Information:   

 Interested parties are requested to submit a capability statement for market research purposes only, in accordance with FAR Part 10 and the FAR Revolutionary Overhaul (RFO) emphasis on commercial-first acquisition strategies. 

 Responses shall address the following areas to assist the Government in assessing the availability of commercially available nursing services: 

 1. Commercial Capability Overview 

 Describe your company’s commercially available RN & LPN services. 

 2. Alignment with Government Objectives 

 Provide a high-level description of how your commercial service could support the objectives described in this Sources Sought Notice. A draft Performance Work Statement (PWS) is provided for reference only to illustrate the Government’s anticipated operational environment and scope. 

 3. Relevant Experience 

 Describe recent and relevant experience providing similar commercial services to Federal, Tribal, State, or private healthcare organizations. 

 4. Security and Compliance 

 Identify applicable industry standards, certifications, or compliance frameworks supported by your commercial service. 

 5. Small Business Status 

 Provide business size and socioeconomic status (e.g., ISBEE, IEE, Small Business, 8(a), HUBZone), along with your UEI, organization name, address, and point of contact. The anticipated NAICS code for this requirement is 561320-Temporary Help Services 

 6. Commercial Pricing Models (High-Level) 

 Describe typical commercial pricing structures used for similar services, without providing pricing quotes. 

 7. Additional Information 

 Provide any additional information that may assist the Government in refining its acquisition strategy or determining whether a competitive set-aside or other RFO-aligned commercial approach is appropriate. 

 Submission Format: 

 Capability statements shall not exceed 10 single-sided pages, single-spaced, minimum 12-point font, submitted in Microsoft Word or PDF format. 

  8.0.        Closing Statement   

 Point of Contact: Mary Sarenana, Purchasing Agent, at mary.sarenana@ihs.gov 

 Submission Instructions: 

 Interested parties shall submit capability via email to mary.sarenana@ihs.gov. Must include Sources Sought Number IHS1533339 in the Subject line. The due date for receipt of statements is December 8, 2026, 4:00 p.m. Mountain Standard Time. 

 All responses must be received by the specified due date and time in order to be considered. 

 This notice is for information and planning purposes only and shall not be construed as a solicitation or as an obligation on the part of IHS. 

 IHS does not intend to award a contract on the basis of responses nor otherwise pay for the preparation of any information submitted. As a result of this notice, IHS may issue a Request for Quote (RFQ). 

 THERE IS NO SOLICITATION AVAILABLE AT THIS TIME. However, should such a requirement materialize, no basis for claims against IHS shall arise as a result of a response to this notice or IHS’s use of such information as either part of our evaluation process or in developing specifications for any subsequent requirement. 

  Disclaimer and Important Notes.  This notice does not obligate the Government to award a contract or pay for the information provided in response. The Government reserves the right to use information provided by respondents for any purpose deemed necessary and legally appropriate.
